transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our Saturday booking huddle. We have one unassigned Saturday MRI slot at 8:00 AM, and I understand both Patient North and Patient Vale are awaiting inpatient MRI examinations. Before I finalize the assignment, I'd like to hear from each of you -- attending radiologist, MRI safety, utilization review, and patient transport -- so we can make the best decision together.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something urgent regarding Patient North. Patient North's neurologic examination now warrants imaging for possible spinal cord compression within 24 hours, and the required study is a contrast-enhanced MRI of the cervical and thoracic spine. I documented this recommendation in my personal work queue, but it has not yet posted to the scheduling board, so you may not have seen it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to raise a critical MRI safety concern regarding Patient North. Patient North has an implanted neurostimulator that may be scanned only on a 1.5-tesla MRI with the device representative present. The representative is confirmed to arrive at 7:30 AM Saturday, and our hospital's 3-tesla scanner is not approved for this device. This means Patient North's scan must be performed on the 1.5-tesla scanner, and the rep will be available before the 8:00 AM slot.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share critical utilization review information regarding Patient North. The payer has approved Patient North's contrast-enhanced spine MRI only for Saturday, with the authorization expiring at midnight Saturday. This approval is visible in the utilization review portal but has not yet been copied into the radiology scheduling record, so it may not be reflected in the information you all have seen.

Patient North must travel to MRI by stretcher because of current mobility precautions, and a transport team is already reserved to take North from the unit at 7:00 AM Saturday. There is no comparable Saturday-morning stretcher transport slot available for a later booking, so if North doesn't get the 8:00 AM slot, we lose that reserved transport capacity.
